name: Ebed Melech
overview: Ebed Melech, an Ethiopian eunuch serving in the king's house, demonstrates courageous faith and compassion by intervening to rescue the prophet Jeremiah from a dungeon where he was left to die of hunger. Recognizing the injustice done to Jeremiah, Ebed Melech appeals to the king, who then commands him to bring men to safely remove Jeremiah using old rags and cords. This account highlights God's providential care through a faithful servant who acts boldly to preserve His prophet, underscoring the theme of divine protection amidst adversity.
